description: Fork of exp193 (val_bpb=2.0067 @ 8K). Single change: untie lm_head from token embedding — head.weight is its own [VOCAB, E] tensor, std=0.02 init. Hypothesis: with V2D+per-head-QKV attention, tok_emb and the unembedder vector for each token live in different geometries; tying is forcing them to share, which may be the dominant bottleneck.
